uncited: Voxel-Specific Shading Pipelines compute illumination for data stored in discrete 3D voxel grids, handling both surface-like boundaries and volumetric density.
All methods operate on a 3D voxel grid indexed by integer coordinates $(x, y, z)$ .

Lighting calculations frequently depend on immediate neighboring voxels to determine occlusion or shading factors, rather than casting long-distance rays for every sample, except in explicit ray-marching variants .
Inputs include block types, palette indices, or continuous scalar/vector fields stored in the voxel cells .
